title: Bone morphogenetic protein 4 meets artificial intelligence: a comprehensive review of AI-driven advances in drug discovery, structural modeling, and clinical translation.
authors: Sun, Wanli; Huo, Tongtong; Ye, Zhewei; Wei, Wu; Sun, Yanqing; Cai, Hui
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统梳理了AI在BMP4蛋白结构预测、药物发现及临床转化中的应用，虽以BMP4为对象且涉及结构建模，但以综述为主、缺乏方法创新，且未聚焦于蛋白质结构计算核心问题。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bone Morphogenetic Protein 4 (BMP4), a member of the transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta) superfamily, plays pivotal roles in embryonic development, tissue homeostasis, and disease pathogenesis-including cancer, fibrosis, and fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP). The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) methodologies over the past 5 years has created unprecedented opportunities for understanding and therapeutically targeting BMP4 biology at multiple scales, from atomic-resolution structure prediction to population-level clinical prognostication. OBJECTIVE: This review systematically examines the intersection of BMP4 biology and AI across three core domains: (1) AI-driven drug discovery targeting BMP4 signaling pathways, (2) deep learning-based protein structure prediction and computational modeling of BMP4 and its receptor complexes, and (3) clinical AI applications for BMP4-associated diseases. METHODS: A narrative review with systematic search elements was conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, bioRxiv, and arXiv for English-language publications from 2020 to 2026, supplemented by targeted searches via Semantic Scholar. Included studies were categorized as BMP4-specific, BMP receptor/BMP-pathway-targeted, or transferable AI methodology not yet applied to BMP4. RESULTS: We find that AI has accelerated BMP4-related research along multiple axes, though with important caveats. AlphaFold3 and related tools have generated high-confidence predicted models of BMP4-receptor complex architecture, aspects of which were previously intractable to experimental structure determination; these predictions remain to be fully validated experimentally. ML-guided virtual screening has identified first-in-class BMP pathway (receptor) modulators for FOP, although BMP4-specific small-molecule modulators have not yet been identified computationally. Single-cell transcriptomics combined with machine learning have revealed BMP4's context-dependent roles in glioblastoma cell state transitions and cancer-associated fibroblast biology; and LASSO-Cox regression models incorporating BMP4 expression have shown promising prognostic value in pancreatic adenocarcinoma and gastric cancer, pending prospective validation. Significant gaps persist-most notably the absence of BMP4-specific de novo protein design efforts, the scarcity of large-scale training datasets for BMP4-targeted drug discovery, and the limited integration of multimodal AI approaches in BMP4 clinical research. CONCLUSION: The convergence of BMP4 biology and AI represents a fertile research Frontier. While foundational tools are now in place, realizing the full translational potential of AI-augmented BMP4 research will require coordinated efforts in data generation, model development, and rigorous experimental and clinical validation. We outline priority directions for the next 5 years (approximately 2026-2031).
abstract_zh: 背景：骨形态发生蛋白4（Bone Morphogenetic Protein 4, BMP4）是转化生长因子-β（transforming growth factor-beta, TGF-beta）超家族成员，在胚胎发育、组织稳态及疾病发病机制（包括癌症、纤维化和进行性骨化性纤维发育不良（fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva, FOP））中发挥关键作用。过去5年人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）和机器学习（machine learning, ML）方法的快速发展，为在多个尺度上理解和治疗性靶向BMP4生物学创造了前所未有的机遇，从原子分辨率结构预测到群体水平临床预后评估。目的：本综述系统考察BMP4生物学与AI在三个核心领域的交叉：（1）靶向BMP4信号通路的AI驱动药物发现，（2）基于深度学习的BMP4及其受体复合物蛋白质结构预测和计算建模，以及（3）BMP4相关疾病的临床AI应用。方法：在PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、bioRxiv和arXiv中对2020至2026年英文文献进行叙述性综述并辅以系统性检索要素，另通过Semantic Scholar进行定向检索。纳入研究被分类为BMP4特异性、BMP受体/BMP通路靶向，或尚未应用于BMP4的可迁移AI方法。结果：我们发现AI沿多个轴线加速了BMP4相关研究，但存在重要注意事项。AlphaFold3及相关工具已生成BMP4-受体复合物结构的高置信度预测模型，其中部分方面此前难以通过实验结构测定解决；这些预测仍有待充分实验验证。ML引导的虚拟筛选已鉴定出用于FOP的首创类BMP通路（受体）调节剂，但BMP4特异性小分子调节剂尚未通过计算手段鉴定。单细胞转录组学结合机器学习揭示了BMP4在胶质母细胞瘤细胞状态转变和癌症相关成纤维细胞生物学中的背景依赖性作用；纳入BMP4表达的LASSO-Cox回归模型在胰腺腺癌和胃癌中显示出有前景的预后价值，有待前瞻性验证。显著空白仍然存在——最突出的是缺乏BMP4特异性从头蛋白质设计工作、BMP4靶向药物发现的大规模训练数据集稀缺，以及多模态AI方法在BMP4临床研究中整合有限。结论：BMP4生物学与AI的融合代表了一个富有前景的研究前沿。尽管基础工具现已就位，但实现AI增强型BMP4研究的全部转化潜力，需要在数据生成、模型开发及严格实验和临床验证方面开展协调努力。我们概述了未来5年（约2026-2031年）的优先方向。
